body:
# 🐞 bug report ### Affected Package The issue is caused by package @angular/compiler-cli ### Is this a regression? There is no such problem with ViewEngine ### Description I'm trying to build a pretty large application with Ivy using latest beta version, but the build fails with the error messages posted below. ## 🔬 Minimal Reproduction I have found that the Error1 (see below) is caused by this component annotation: ``` @Component({ selector: 'sm-chart', template: `
`, changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush }) ``` As soon as I remove [ngStyle] binding the Error1 is gone, but Error2(see below) arises, which is probably caused by the same root issue. Error2 seems to be related to ng-select library we are using in the project. Here is the element definition from the tcbProcessDirective method which causes the Error2:
Click to expand
